例句

  1. It is not until you go abroad that you realize how many neon lights there are in big Japanese cities.
    要等到出國之後，你才會發現日本的大城市裡有多少霓虹燈。
  2. It was not until midnight that he came home.
    他到半夜才回家。
  3. It is not until you get sick that you know the value of health.
    人要等到生病，才知道健康的可貴。
  4. It was not until I got home that I noticed my phone was missing.
    我到家之後才發現我的手機不見了。
  5. It was not until last year that I learned to swim.
    我到去年才學會游泳。
  6. It is not until you live alone that you understand how hard your parents worked.
    要等到一個人住，你才懂你爸媽工作多辛苦。
  7. It was not until the next morning that the snow stopped.
    雪到隔天早上才停。
  8. It was not until Tom left that we found his bag.
    Tom 離開之後，我們才發現他的包包。
  9. Do you know how many students there are in this school?
    你知道這所學校有多少學生嗎？
  10. I was surprised at how many people there were at the station.
    車站裡的人多到讓我很驚訝。
  11. Can you count how many eggs there are in the box?
    你可以數一下盒子裡有幾顆蛋嗎？
  12. Nobody knows how many stars there are in the sky.
    沒有人知道天上有多少星星。
  13. I asked the guide how many temples there were in Kyoto.
    我問導遊京都有多少間寺廟。
  14. I didn't realize how many convenience stores there are in Taipei.
    我之前沒發現台北有那麼多便利商店。
  15. Look at how many cars there are on the road today.
    看看今天路上有多少車。
  16. It was not until I visited Tokyo that I realized how many people there are in the city.
    我去了東京之後，才發現這個城市有多少人。
  17. It is not until you clean your room that you see how many things there are on the floor.
    要等到打掃房間，你才會看到地上有多少東西。
  18. It was not until we checked our report again that we saw how many mistakes there were.
    我們再檢查一次報告，才發現裡面有那麼多錯。
  19. It is not until you lose something that you know how important it is.
    要等到失去一樣東西，你才知道它有多重要。
  20. It was not until I was twenty that I went abroad for the first time.
    我到二十歲才第一次出國。
  21. I wonder how many people there are in this stadium.
    不知道這個體育場裡有多少人。
  22. It was not until the bus left that I noticed my bag was still on it.
    公車開走之後，我才發現我的包包還在車上。
  23. Tell me how many chairs there are in the room.
    告訴我房間裡有幾張椅子。
  24. It is not until summer comes that this beach gets crowded.
    要到夏天來了，這片海灘才會變擁擠。
  25. I can't believe how many vending machines there are in Japan.
    我不敢相信日本有那麼多自動販賣機。
  26. It was not until I became a parent that I understood my mother.
    我到自己當了父母，才懂我媽媽。
  27. It is not until you go to Hokkaido in winter that you know how cold Japan can be.
    要等到冬天去北海道，你才知道日本可以有多冷。
  28. Do you know how many languages there are in the world?
    你知道世界上有多少種語言嗎？
  29. It was not until I read the news that I learned about the earthquake.
    我看了新聞才知道地震的事。
  30. My grandfather was surprised at how many tall buildings there were in Taipei.
    我爺爺很驚訝台北有那麼多高樓。
